annotations.title: Work a plan out for a month, and use it

description: One plan worked out for one month: net pay, the bills out of net, what is left to split, each bucket’s amount and share, what it actually got lately, when a goal is reached at this rate, money with no job to do — and what *using* the plan for that month would write (a planned deposit into a goal, a planned payment on a debt). **Dry-runs by default**, which is also how you read it; `commit: true` writes those suggestions and gives the month this plan. `months` instead gives a list of months this plan and writes nothing else, and `back_to_default` puts months of this plan back on the default — the Plan screen’s month checkboxes. A month nobody gave a plan is on the default. `only_buckets` writes just those buckets’ suggestions. A fund or an account is pointed at and writes nothing. The document is copied to a timestamped .bak first.

back_to_default.description: Months as YYYY-MM of this plan to put back on the default plan.

commit.description: Default false. False shows the month and writes nothing; true uses the plan.

month.description: The month as YYYY-MM. Default this month.

months.description: Months as YYYY-MM to give this plan. Records nothing.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

plan_id.description: Ids come from `plans`. Default: the default plan.

name: plan_month
